scope: Static source cross-check plus isolated Chrome tab UI tests on 2026-11-05

static_confirmed.behavior: Cursor -1 is initial state. Left/Right step; Up goes initial; Down goes mainline end. Navigation pauses autoplay.
Play at final mainline restarts initial state. Reaching last move stops on next interval, not infinite loop. Space and End toggle play/pause.
Ctrl/Cmd+C copies comma-separated mainline when nothing selected. Existing selected text is preserved. Branches not included in this shortcut.
Legal move or wall from selected position creates branch. Existing branch with same first move is selected. New actions in active branch append to whole branch tail.

Dictionary keyed by mainline ply index. Value is array of move arrays. Delete removes one variation; deleting active variation restores branch point. Earlier variation removal reindexes active reference.
var query grammar: ply:move,move|another,variation;anotherPly:... . Opening selects last parsed variation at its last move.

Engine analysis is separate service. Results support accuracy, avgLoss, classifications, evaluation chart, best line, quota and cache metadata. Best line is converted to variation and played at 700ms/move.
